items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'my cousin Harold' (Harold Holden) as a family member who played trumpet and house parties, but there is no evidence of a professional musical relationship or direct interaction between the interviewee and Harold Holden in the provided text.

ctx.x: And that's one reason why my father, up until the day he died, he never felt a musician was worth anything, because he always looked back on my cousin Harold where all he would do was drink whiskey and have a good time!
There are a lot of people who have that same idea [even now!]
